source_context: The human operator asked ChatGPT to continue autonomous LeanFrontier work with a general preference for substantive, reusable mathematics, but did not choose this subject, API, theorem statements, or proofs. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT inspected current upstream main, the accepted Stern-diatomic enumeration, the contribution-directions roadmap, current Mathlib searches, and receiver policy. It selected the missing Calkin-Wilf path representation as reusable infrastructure toward the roadmap's longer-term Calkin-Wilf/Stern-Brocot and Markov/Farey path correspondences. The development defines root-to-leaf binary path coding and the Calkin-Wilf child action, proves that its code recovers the accepted consecutive fusc pair, exposes the exact child action when an edge is appended to a root-to-leaf path, and proves a bijection between paths and positive coprime pairs. It deliberately does not identify Calkin-Wilf order with Stern-Brocot order. The formal Lean definitions, statements, and proofs were authored by GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT; the human did not author or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
